subject: gk
question: When the Constitution of India was being drafted, the Constituent Assembly had to take into account the unrest that India was going through. Which of the following was not relevant in that scenario?

options.text: The socio-economic condition of the people was very favorable.
The princely state was uncertain about its future.
The country was made up of many different communities.
The partition of India and Pakistan was confirmed.

solution:
The correct answer is __**The socio-economic condition of the people was very favourable.**__
